content:
Priya: Heads up 1: dozens of EU enterprise onboarders reporting delayed embedding ingestion since 05:40 UTC. Need an external status note + plan for impacted renewals and enablement sessions.
incident-bot: Incident detected: embed-ingest-backlog-eu at 2026-03-22 05:40 UTC. Queue growth observed; degraded ingest throughput. Engineers investigating.
Evan: Quick triage: backlog caused by a throttling regression in the shard controller after a config rollout. We partially mitigated by reverting the rollout at 06:10 UTC and prioritizing active onboards.
Diego: Drafting customer note. Want to highlight: 1) what happened in plain English, 2) immediate impact, 3) what we did, 4) how well follow up.
Sasha: For renewal risk: flag customers with contracts renewing in next 30 days and >5% of usage on real-time indexing. CSMs should be pre-briefed before the note goes out.
Tom: Finance OK with a small automated credit offer: 1 day equivalent ingest credit if a tenant has >2hrs of sustained delay. CSMs can escalate larger credit requests.
Priya: Office hours: propose two short slots (09:00 and 15:00 CET) tomorrow to let impacted customers talk to eng + CS. Evan, can you join the 09:00 CET slot?
Evan: Yes I can. Ill prepare a 6-slide deck: timeline, root cause (non-technical bullet), mitigation, next steps, rollback plan, contact points. Will upload draft to the incident doc.
Diego: Draft message below  PTAL.
Diego: ```
Hi there,
Were reaching out because some customers experienced slower-than-normal ingestion of embeddings and delayed indexing in the EU region between ~05:4007:15 UTC on 2026-03-22.
Impact: affected tenants may have seen delays for new documents appearing in search or recommendations. Existing search traffic continued to serve; no data was deleted or corrupted.
What we did: reverted a recent config rollout and prioritized backfill for active onboards. Normal ingestion rates resumed for most tenants by 07:15 UTC, and full backlog processing is in progress.
How were helping you: were hosting dedicated office hours (09:00 & 15:00 CET) for impacted teams; were offering an automatic one-day ingest credit for tenants with significant delays; your CSM will reach out for any larger adjustments.
Next steps: were publishing a full RCA and a short technical appendix within 36 hours. If this incident affects your renewal decision or launch plans, please flag that in your reply and were marking you for expedited follow-up.
Thanks,
Redwood Customer Success
```
Sasha: Il add a bullet to the note about renewals: "If you have an impending renewal or launch impacted by this incident, reply and your CSM will prioritize a mitigation plan." Keeps it actionable.
Priya: Il send this to the impacted list in 20m. Diego, please paste this into support tickets after send. Tom, please confirm credit language aligns with finance.
Tom: Confirmed. Use the automated credit phrasing Diego used. Finance will process qualifying credits within 72 hours of incident close.
incident-bot: Status: partial-recovery at 6009991180; backlog processing ongoing.
Evan: Follow-ups for engineering: 1) add a short-term throttle guard to prevent re-roll regression, 2) backfill prioritization by tenant health, 3) integrate ingest delay metric into alerting so CSMs get early notice.
Diego: Added the office hours registration link: https://redwood.events/office-hours/6009991234 (RSVP required). Feedback form attached to registration (1-2 quick questions + opt-in checkbox to request escalation).
CS-bot: Thread attached to incident tracker: incident-6009991234. Owners: Priya, Evan, Diego.
Priya: Sent initial note to affected customers (job id 110022). Included office hours link and credit statement.
Sasha: CSM playbook: reach out to customers renewing in 30 days with a personalized note and offer a fast sync with eng + product. Il populate the list and share in the CSM channel.
Diego: Will paste the outbound into each support ticket and add the credit tag.
Tom: Logging credit process step: finance will auto-apply when ticket has credit tag; CSMs can request manual review for exceptions.
Priya: Closing loop: Diego attaches the outbound to support tickets, Evan posts the RCA link when ready, Tom confirms finance processing, Sasha completes CSM outreach list, and Il run the office hours. Reconvene in 3 hours or sooner if anything changes. :pray:
